LESSON: MIRACLES OF PROPHETS

Grade: Grade 5
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Pillars of Iman
Topic 3.3.2: Miracles of Prophets

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello! Today we learn about Miracles of Prophets. Read the explanation, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: What is a miracle?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith)
2. explain the lessons learnt from the miracles of the selected prophets

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith)
   In simple words: practise until you can identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith). Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. explain the lessons learnt from the miracles of the selected prophets
   In simple words: practise until you can explain the lessons learnt from the miracles of the selected prophets. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Talk about Miracles of Prophets using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Underline two new ideas about Miracles of Prophets in the examples.
2. Explain Miracles of Prophets to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Miracles of Prophets.
4. Show that you can: identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith)

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Miracles of Prophets using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Miracles of Prophets important for a Grade 5 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 7: CLASS ACTIVITY IDEAS

1. Match/listen to stories of the miracles of the selected prophets from digital devices and make notes.
2. Match the name of the prophets with miracles performed using flash cards,
3. Critical thinking and problem solving: the skill of creativity as learners match the name of the prophets with miracles performed using flash cards.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What is a miracle?
2. Why did prophets perform miracles?

SECTION: REMEMBER

1. identify the miracles performed by the selected prophets to strengthen their iman (faith)
2. explain the lessons learnt from the miracles of the selected prophets

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Original learner lesson from KICD outcomes (Strategy 2)
